metadataRaw.title: 3 Moves to Release a Tight Psoas (HIP FLEXORS)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 3 simple moves to help release muscle pain and tightness in the psoas muscle (and hip flexors). 

Great part is no equipment is needed other than a couch, and can be done daily for both quick and long-lasting psoas muscle pain relief. 

Let us know how it works for you!

For more info about the psoas and hip flexor muscles: https://youtu.be/kibVUeXFmwA
